entries.german:
Berichte von Rosenberg, ob Serenissimi den Strecker zu Bronnacker in preußischen Diensten anzunehmen gnädigst gewillet

Laufzeit: 1750
entries.english:
Reports by Rosenberg on whether Their Serene Highnesses are graciously willing to accept Strecker of Bronnacker into Prussian service.

Period covered: 1750
